outcome: Levels of specific urinary metabolites (e.g., betaine, citrate, lactate, creatine, taurine)
cohort: The study included 35 newborns with congenital cytomegalovirus infection and 15 healthy uninfected control newborns.
finding: Newborns with congenital cytomegalovirus infection exhibit a distinct urinary metabolomic fingerprint compared to healthy controls, with differing levels of various metabolites.
